name: ks-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Kansas corporate income tax for tax year 2026, the Form K-120 filing duty for corporations doing business in or deriving income from Kansas sources, automatic Subchapter S status for Kansas (banks excluded, they file the privilege tax), the repealed franchise tax, and federal-extension mechanics. Trigger on "Kansas corporate income tax", "K-120", "K-120S", "Kansas privilege tax banks", "KDOR corporate". Use the APEX-adjusted 3.5% normal rate plus 3% surtax over USD50,000; Notice23-10 effective2024 controls the earlier reduction. Notice25-06 announces no additional revenue-triggered reduction for2026.
